task_objective: Fix .jsonl files being silently parsed as CSV by the DuckDB engine, and remove the dead, contradictory SUPPORTED_EXTENSIONS constant.
design_decisions: Root cause was the catch-all else arm in _register_view, which guessed CSV for any unknown suffix and so hid the missing .jsonl branch. Dispatch now goes through SourceFormat.from_path with no fallback, making SourceFormat the single source of truth and letting UnsupportedFormatError surface through the existing execute()/get_schema() boundaries.
The match statement is left exhaustive with no default arm on purpose: ty verifies exhaustiveness, so adding a SourceFormat member fails type-check rather than failing at runtime.

The unreachable .xls arm was removed with the constant. SourceFormat.from_path rejects .xls, so no .xls file could ever reach the engine; SUPPORTED_EXTENSIONS claiming otherwise was part of the drift.
SUPPORTED_EXTENSIONS was deleted rather than corrected — a second list of supported formats is what allowed the divergence, and the file dialog's _build_filter() already derives from SourceFormat.
Implementation delegated to codex gpt-5.6-terra under TDD; verified independently rather than on the strength of its report.

results.implementer: codex gpt-5.6-terra, workspace-write, tmux session codex-jsonl
results.verification: Gates re-run by the reviewing agent, not taken from the implementer log.
results.mutation_check: Reverting the JSON_LINES arm to from_csv_auto fails test_duckdb_engine_reads_json_lines_as_typed_columns and test_duckdb_get_schema_reads_json_lines_fields; restored afterwards.
results.note: The file-dialog parity test passed during RED because the hardcoded initialFilter string happened to match _build_filter() output; it is a drift guard, not a defect reproduction.
